zoo.fallow.aide.maitriser: Its other stamps, then watch it up close.

repos.fallow.bien_repose: You rest, warm and snug at home.
tannerie.fallow.chevalet.occupe: A hide is already on the beam: scrape it with a knife.
tannerie.fallow.cuve.sans_eau: The vat is empty: pour in a bucket of water.
tannerie.fallow.cuve.a_vider: The leather is ready: take it out first, with an empty hand.
tannerie.fallow.cuve.tan_plein: The vat takes no more bark.
tannerie.fallow.cuve.pleine: The vat is full: four hides at most.
tannerie.fallow.cuve.sans_tan: Not enough tannin: one bark per hide.
tannerie.fallow.sechoir.occupe: The frame already holds a leather.
tannerie.fallow.sechoir.cause.ombre: In the shade, it dries slowly.
commands.fallow.hotes.inconnu: No People goes by that name.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.accueil: Ah… there you are. Or is it me letting myself be seen, little light? Down here, nobody quite knows who finds whom.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.accueil.2: Hush… there, against the moss, by your feet. No, nothing now. The Hidden One was there, and then she chose not to be.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.accueil.3: You kept your lamp lit all the way, and the mist let it through… so stay, if you like, and don't make big gestures.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.don: Have you brought us something? Glow berries, perhaps… or a bottle of honey… or a little bone meal, to help the moss grow back?
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.merci: You set it down gently, and you looked at the moss before stepping back. We saw it all, little light. Well… almost all.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.merci.2: You asked nothing in return… so something will wait for you at dawn, and you won't know straight away that it was us.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.refus: That's all right… the moss is in no hurry to grow back either. Were you looking for something, down here?
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.demande: A question? Ask it slowly, then… answers take their time to grow here.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.question.bete: The Hidden One? She may be behind you right now. Archie calls her a Lushsaur. Hold out glow berries without moving, for a long while… and she'll show herself.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.question.saiso: In spring, when her heart of moss grows back. Before that we stay deep… and after, we rise with the mist, still a little green.
screen.fallow.hote.ecorce.question.lieu: Go down, following the air that smells of wet earth. When berries hang lower than your head, or blue mushrooms light up on their own, you're at her home.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.accueil: Heat-bearer. You arrive as the fire runs low. Good timing: we were just counting what's left.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.accueil.2: Three embers in the hearth, one in your chest. That makes four. Sit by the four.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.accueil.3: The mist is cold tonight. It carried us here all the same. A Stoker never leaves empty-handed, heat-bearer.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.don: Charcoal. A magma block. Well-cooked mutton. The hearth hungers for three things. Choose.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.merci: Noted in the store. Enough to last until the next moon, maybe two. The Full One thanks you, in his way.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.merci.2: Good weight. The hearth goes up a notch. Come back when it drops: your place is kept, heat-bearer.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.refus: The store stays as it is. Fine, this once. Don't come back empty twice in a row.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.demande: A question. One at a time. Fire doesn't like being talked over.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.question.bete: The Full One, when he has his lava. The Empty One, when he hasn't, and then we step aside. In Archie's book: Obsidiceratops. We fill his store, and we don't argue.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.question.saiso: Winter. When everything freezes outside, people look for fire. And looking for fire, they find us.
screen.fallow.hote.braise.question.lieu: Dig until the stone turns warm, then red. Where redstone grows in spikes from floor and ceiling, with lava close by: that's the Full One's home.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.accueil: A lone voice. Lone, yes. We heard your voice from afar, and the whole flight turned its head.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.accueil.2: The mist breaks the light into seven tonight. Seven colours, and you in the middle. The middle, yes. Come closer.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.accueil.3: We were at the bottom of the chasm, and now we're here. One leap, just one. Do you always travel on foot, lone voice?
screen.fallow.hote.givre.don: What will you share? Share, yes: an amethyst shard, a chorus fruit, a feather for gliding.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.merci: We heard it. Heard by all. Your gift will pass from mouth to mouth down to the bottom of the chasm.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.merci.2: Blue, then green, then pink: that's the colour of a gift, with us. You're a little part of the flight now. A little.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.refus: We fly back up. Back up, yes. Call us when you have something to share.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.demande: Ask your question. Your question, yes. The flight will take it up, and the answer will come in many voices.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.question.bete: The Crywing seldom flies alone. Seldom, yes. If one cries out, all know where you are. Archie writes Chorusoatl. Hold out a chorus fruit, and keep still while she hesitates.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.question.saison: Autumn, when the flights pass over the chasms. Over, yes. Then we brood in the dark.
screen.fallow.hote.givre.question.lieu: Look for a very deep chasm where the stone shines every colour: the prismachasm. The light turns blue there, then green, then nothing. Nothing, yes. That's the place.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.accueil: Surface. Breathe. Listen. There, Airling: a chest full of air, and all of it just for you. Such wealth.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.accueil.2: The mist is almost heavy enough to swim in. Almost. We walked the rest of the way, and believe me, that's long.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.accueil.3: A bubble rose near you a moment ago. You didn't see it. It saw you.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.don: Carry us something. A fish, some kelp, a sea pickle that glows. We'll carry it further.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.merci: You have enough air for two tonight. And one morning a bubble will burst beside you: that'll be us, saying it arrived.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.merci.2: Hoisted. Carried. Set down higher. With us nothing stays at the bottom for long, Airling: everything rises in the end.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.refus: Catch your breath. The tide comes by twice a day, and we nearly as often.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.demande: Go on, Airling. But quickly: down here, a question is a breath of air.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.question.bete: The Bearer keeps her head in the warm sand, and her bubbles give her away. Archie says Coralosaur. Once tamed, she lends you her air underwater.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.question.saison: Summer, when the water is warm to the bottom and the fish come up to find us.
screen.fallow.hote.fonds.question.lieu: Go to a warm sea, where the sand is pale and coral grows into a reef. Look for a column of bubbles rising from the bottom, and dive to its foot: the Bearer is underneath.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.accueil: Ho, ground-dweller! We saw you coming from the third fork: you walk like someone who's never climbed. Sit down, make yourself at home!
screen.fallow.hote.sables.accueil.2: Rain, vines, bamboo, mud, and you in the middle, bone dry. How do you do it? No, don't tell us, we like to guess.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.accueil.3: Fell a tree in passing and you'll find it across your path. You didn't cut anything on the way? Good. We watched anyway.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.don: What did you bring up for us? Melon, bamboo, cocoa beans? With us, a gift is counted in heaps, not handfuls.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.merci: Now that fills! Four times four, that's how we say thank you here. You gave one. It's a start.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.merci.2: The Great Leaner will hear of it before tonight. He won't look at you, he looks at no one, but the leaves tell him everything.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.refus: Nothing in the basket? Then the jungle will watch you pass. It loves empty hands: it laughs about them for days.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.demande: Ask, dig, help yourself! One, two, three questions, four if you like. Here we love answering almost as much as eating.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.question.bete: The Great Leaner! Tall as two trunks, slow as rain, and he barely notices you. Archie says Therimoss. He wants a pyramid of food: twenty blocks. And don't cut trees near him.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.question.saiso: When the rain lasts three days and everyone stays under the leaves. Others call it bad weather. For us, it's a feast.
screen.fallow.hote.sables.question.lieu: Head for the heat, where the trees are so tall the sun arrives in pieces: the jungle. Climb to the second fork of the great trees: the Great Leaner rests against one of them.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.accueil: Light-step. You walked without a sound. Sit. Gently.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.accueil.2: Don't speak yet. Listen first. Nothing? Then we can talk. Low.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.accueil.3: The ground listens here too. Less than below. Enough that we whisper.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.don: Leave wool. An echo shard. A candle. Nothing else.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.merci.2: It's there. Not a word more. The One Below won't hear a thing.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.refus: Go. Without a sound, as you came.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.question.bete: The One Below. Archie says Sculksaur. She can't be tamed. She mustn't be woken. We keep her sleep.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.question.sais: No seasons, down below. We come on moonless nights. The dark is the same all year.
screen.fallow.hote.silence.question.lieu: Very deep, under the dark stone, a dead city covered in sculk. The ground answers steps there. If it answers, back away.
postes.fallow.livre.ailleurs.raclage: The hide is scraped on the fleshing beam.
postes.fallow.livre.ailleurs.tannage: The scraped hide is tanned in the tanning vat.
postes.fallow.livre.ailleurs.sechage: The wet leather dries on the drying frame.
postes.fallow.forge.pret: %s: crouch with the hammer in hand and strike the anvil.

eveil.fallow.table.vide: The table waits for an item that has lived.
eveil.fallow.table.rien: The table finds nothing to awaken in this item.
eveil.fallow.table.pas_encore: This item has not lived enough yet.
eveil.fallow.table.plein: This item has already given all it could.
eveil.fallow.table.rien_a_apprendre: This item has nothing left to learn.
eveil.fallow.eclat.ne_prend_pas: This shard does not take on this item.
eveil.fallow.eclat.deja: This item already bears this power, or one that opposes it.
eveil.fallow.tooltip.pret: An awakening awaits, at the enchanting table
eveil.fallow.tooltip.eteint: Worn out: an awakening has faded
postes.fallow.sechoir.sec: The leather is dry: take it with an empty hand.
eveil.fallow.message.alerte: %s is weakening. Worn out, this item will forget %s.
eveil.fallow.tooltip.palier.0: Still a stranger to your hand
eveil.fallow.tooltip.alerte: Weakening: worn out, it will forget %s
eveil.fallow.recit.frostmaw: Frostmaw's frost still sleeps in it: water turns to ice under your steps.
eveil.fallow.recit.ferrous_wroughtnaut: Torn from the Wroughtnaut's armour, which gave way to no blow.
eveil.fallow.recit.umvuthi: Umvuthi's light still burns what death has raised.
eveil.fallow.recit.naga: The breath of the Naga, who lived between air and water.
eveil.fallow.recit.sculptor: The Sculptor never fell: its shard holds you back.
eveil.fallow.recit.obsidiceratops: The Obsidiceratops' hide did not fear lava.
eveil.fallow.acte.lance: %s creatures hit by a thrown trident
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.fire_prot: Reduces fire and lava damage; you burn for less time.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.respirati: You hold your breath longer under water.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.aqua_affi: You work under water as fast as in the air.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.swift_sne: You move crouched almost at full pace.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.bane_of_a: Strikes spiders and insects hard, and slows them.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.fire_aspe: Sets what you strike on fire.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.sweeping_: The sweep cuts harder around you.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.silk_touc: The block comes whole, as it was.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.loyalty: The thrown trident comes back to hand.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.impaling: Strikes hard what lives in water.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.riptide: Thrown in water or rain, it carries you along.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.channelin: In a storm, calls down lightning.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.piercing: The bolt goes through several targets.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.mending: Mends itself by living: every deed repairs it a little.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.density: The higher the fall, the heavier the blow.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.minecraft.wind_burs: A crushing blow throws you up again.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.create.potato_recov: The cannon's shots can sometimes be picked up.
eveil.fallow.pouvoir.supplementaries.sta: What the slingshot throws does not fall.
eveil.fallow.livre.invite: Lay on the table an item that has lived. It awakens through what it has done: the pickaxe through what it dug, the sword through what it defeated, the armour through the blows it took.
eveil.fallow.livre.invite_eclat: A great beast's shard goes on the right: it gives its strength at once.
eveil.fallow.livre.choisir: Click a path to awaken it.
eveil.fallow.livre.eclat.verser: Click the page to pour the shard into the item.
eveil.fallow.livre.eclat.sans_objet: Lay on the left the item that will receive it.
eveil.fallow.livre.eclat.place: The shard needs no deed, but it takes an awakening's place.
